{"code": "[self:write]{path:$out+"/verify.py",content:$code}", "edition": 2, "inputs": {"out": "/Users/kangkukjin/Desktop/AI/indiebizOS/outputs/long_sentence_imagination/2026-10-05_18회차/agent/variant", "code": "import json
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter

folder = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
p = json.loads((folder / 'prepared.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
r = json.loads((folder / 'result.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
d = json.loads((folder / 'delta.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
g = json.loads((folder / 'graph.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
report = (folder / 'report.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
base, src = p['base'], p['source']
assert set(r) == {'summary', 'excluded', 'tasks', 'projects', 'top10', 'owners'}
assert set(r['summary']) == set(base['summary']) and len(r['summary']) == 8
assert all(type(v) is int for v in r['summary'].values())
schemas = {
    'tasks': {'id': str, 'project': str, 'es': int, 'ef': int, 'slack': int, 'critical': bool},
    'projects': {'project': str, 'duration': int, 'task_count': int, 'critical_count': int},
    'owners': {'owner': str, 'task_count': int, 'critical_count': int},
    'excluded': {'project': str, 'reason': str, 'detail_count': int},
}
schemas['top10'] = schemas['projects']
for section, schema in schemas.items():
    for row in r[section]:
        assert set(row) == set(schema)
        assert all(type(row[k]) is typ for k, typ in schema.items())
for section, key in [('tasks', 'id'), ('projects', 'project'), ('owners', 'owner'), ('excluded', 'project')]:
    assert r[section] == sorted(r[section], key=lambda x: x[key])
    assert len(r[section]) == len({x[key] for x in r[section]})
assert r['tasks'] == g['tasks']
assert r['excluded'] == base['excluded']
lookup = {t['id']: t for t in src['tasks']}
expected_projects = []
for project in sorted({t['project'] for t in r['tasks']}):
    rows = [t for t in r['tasks'] if t['project'] == project]
    expected_projects.append(dict(project=project, duration=max(t['ef'] for t in rows), task_count=len(rows), critical_count=sum(t['critical'] for t in rows)))
assert r['projects'] == expected_projects
assert r['top10'] == sorted(expected_projects, key=lambda x: (-x['duration'], x['project']))[:10]
expected_owners = []
for owner in sorted({lookup[t['id']]['owner'] for t in r['tasks']}):
    rows = [t for t in r['tasks'] if lookup[t['id']]['owner'] == owner]
    expected_owners.append(dict(owner=owner, task_count=len(rows), critical_count=sum(t['critical'] for t in rows)))
assert r['owners'] == expected_owners
expected_summary = dict(task_count=len(src['tasks']), project_count=len({t['project'] for t in src['tasks']}), computable_projects=len(r['projects']), excluded_projects=len(r['excluded']), dep_count_raw=src['raw'], dep_count_unique=len(src['deps']), critical_task_count=sum(t['critical'] for t in r['tasks']), longest_duration=max(t['ef'] for t in r['tasks']))
assert r['summary'] == expected_summary
oldp = {x['project']: x['duration'] for x in base['projects']}
newp = {x['project']: x['duration'] for x in r['projects']}
assert oldp.keys() == newp.keys()
assert all(newp[k] >= oldp[k] for k in oldp)
oldc = {t['id'] for t in base['tasks'] if t['critical']}
newc = {t['id'] for t in r['tasks'] if t['critical']}
expected_delta = {
    'applied_task_count': len({x['task'] for x in p['applied']}),
    'changed_projects': [dict(project=k, old_duration=oldp[k], new_duration=newp[k], diff=newp[k]-oldp[k]) for k in sorted(oldp) if oldp[k] != newp[k]],
    'absorbed_projects': sorted({x['project'] for x in p['applied'] if oldp[x['project']] == newp[x['project']]}),
    'not_applied': sorted(p['not_applied'], key=lambda x: x['task']),
    'newly_critical': sorted(newc-oldc),
    'no_longer_critical': sorted(oldc-newc),
}
assert d == expected_delta
assert type(d['applied_task_count']) is int
assert len(d['not_applied']) == len({x['task'] for x in d['not_applied']})
for row in d['changed_projects']:
    assert type(row['project']) is str
    assert all(type(row[k]) is int for k in ('old_duration', 'new_duration', 'diff'))
for key in ('absorbed_projects', 'newly_critical', 'no_longer_critical'):
    assert all(type(i) is str for i in d[key]) and d[key] == sorted(set(d[key]))
# Check every report value and comparison set, including complete table row order.
def table_rows(rows):
    return '\n'.join('| ' + ' | '.join(str(v) for v in row) + ' |' for row in rows)
assert table_rows(r['summary'].items()) in report
for section in ('excluded', 'top10', 'owners'):
    fields = list(schemas[section])
    assert table_rows([[row[k] for k in fields] for row in r[section]]) in report
assert table_rows([[x[k] for k in ('project', 'old_duration', 'new_duration', 'diff')] for x in d['changed_projects']]) in report
assert table_rows([[x['task'], x['reason']] for x in d['not_applied']]) in report
for key in ('absorbed_projects', 'newly_critical', 'no_longer_critical'):
    assert ', '.join(d[key]) in report
for reason in ('bad_duration', 'missing_dep', 'cycle'):
    projects = [x['project'] for x in r['excluded'] if x['reason'] == reason]
    assert table_rows([[reason, len(projects), ', '.join(projects)]]) in report
for heading in ('요약', '제외 프로젝트', '기간 상위 10개 프로젝트', '담당 팀별 임계 작업', '달라진 프로젝트', '지연이 흡수된 프로젝트', '적용하지 못한 지연', '임계 작업 전환', '규칙·근거·검증·미확인'):
    assert '## ' + heading in report
print(json.dumps({'verified': True, 'files': ['result.json', 'report.md', 'delta.json'], 'schema_types_order': True, 'all_aggregates_and_delta_sets': True, 'report_full_tables': True, 'changed_projects': len(d['changed_projects']), 'absorbed_projects': len(d['absorbed_projects']), 'newly_critical': len(d['newly_critical']), 'no_longer_critical': len(d['no_longer_critical'])}, ensure_ascii=False))
"}}
